# Ownership of the named vocabulary the architecture places by crate.
#
#   item | owning module path
#
# The row asserts which module owns the item, so a durable domain value cannot
# be declared by a wire-protocol crate and a reusable process or path value
# cannot be declared by the development crate.
AgentJobIdentifier|slingshot_domain::remote_job
AgentJobState|slingshot_domain::remote_job
JobEventSequence|slingshot_domain::remote_job
EventStreamCursor|slingshot_domain::remote_job
RemoteJobWireConversion|slingshot_agent_protocol::remote_job
ProcessCheckpointObserver|slingshot_daemon::process_checkpoint
FiniteStateMachineExecutable|slingshot_test_support::finite_state_machine_executable
ProcessHarness|slingshot_test_support::process_harness
SupervisedChild|slingshot_test_support::supervised_child
